messages.content: which came first the walking dead comic or show

message.content:
The **comic** came first. *The Walking Dead* debuted as a comic book in **2003**, while the TV show premiered in **2010**.[1][6]

If you want, I can also give you a quick side-by-side timeline of the comic, show, and major spin-offs.
